thread:
Maya: heads-up — after the canary swap we saw a spike in client reconnects and duplicate billing for resumed streams :grimacing:
Raj: saw that too. console showed two active sessions for the same resume_token for several minutes
Sean: timeline? is it strictly during shard routing change or also when quota enforcement kicks in?
Olivia: looks like it's when quota backoff fires and requests get routed to cheaper-region fallback. routing policy drop-in + non-sticky assignment
Maya: exact repro i recorded: client holds resume_token=T, connection A drops, reconnect goes to region B, region B validates token against stale lease -> 409, client retries, gets routed to region C which accepts -> two sessions briefly
Raj: so token validate vs lease-owner mismatch on route handoff
Sean: that explains duplicate charge: our billing increments on resume acceptance before previous lease cleanup
Olivia: console UX shows both streams active because we don't atomically mark previous session closed when resume succeeds elsewhere
Maya: logs from proxy attached:
```
2024-11-02T18:31:12.123Z proxy: resume_request token=T client=cid-12 route=us-east validate=lease-owner=us-west status=409
2024-11-02T18:31:12.456Z proxy: retry_assign client=cid-12 route=us-west->eu-west assigned=node-7 status=200 resume_ok
2024-11-02T18:31:12.789Z runtime: session_create token=T node=node-7 billing=allocated
```
Raj: yep. gap where both nodes think session is live
Sean: proposed options:
- centralize resume lease check in control plane (adds sync latency)
- on accept, send steal/terminate to previous owner (racy if it already closed)
- enforce sticky routing for tokens for N seconds after disconnect
Olivia: sticky routing is lowest friction; product might accept minor routing inflexibility briefly
Maya: also need telemetry: console panel showing "resume_mismatch" events and breakdown by route
DevOps Bot: rollout-canary completed by @CI-Bot at 2024-11-02T18:00:00Z :rocket:
Raj: add billing guard: don't finalize invoice for resume acceptance until prior session confirmed closed or until a debounce window
Sean: agreed. create metrics: resume_attempts, validate_409_rate, duplicate_active_sessions, billing_allocates_per_resume
Olivia: quick sandbox test: sticky routing TTL=10s reduced dup rate from ~24/hr -> ~1/hr
Maya: good. proposal: ship sticky=10s as canary routing flag + telemetry + billing debounce. reevaluate after 24h
Raj: i'll prototype control-plane lease-claim RPC too; sticky+debounce is pragmatic short-term
Maya: action items:
- Olivia: feature flag for sticky routing TTL + test infra (ETA 2d)
- Raj: prototype lease-claim RPC (ETA 1w)
- Sean: console panel for resume-mismatch metrics + billing guard (ETA 3d)
- Maya: coordinate canary + update runbook
Sean: pinging @Console Team for dashboard prototype
Console Team: got it, will add widget + alert when duplicate_active_sessions > 5/min
Maya: thanks. sync tomorrow 10:30 to review canary metrics :eyes:
Olivia: adding note in rollout doc with sticky flag and toggle instructions
Raj: adding billing pipeline guard to flag suspicious resume charges before finalize
Maya: perfect. thanks everyone, great catch on the canary monitoring
